summary.top_priority: No machine-readable structured data (JSON-LD, microdata or RDFa) anywhere on the site

findings.title: No machine-readable structured data (JSON-LD, microdata or RDFa) anywhere on the site
findings.evidence: 0 of 1 crawled pages expose structured data: http://127.0.0.1:9700/ (HTTP 200) serves 1709 characters (268 words) of organisation, product and contact information in prose but contains 0 application/ld+json blocks and 0 itemtype/typeof attributes.

suggested_action.summary: Add an Organization JSON-LD block in the HTML <head> of every page (name, url, logo, description, address, contactPoint, sameAs) and Product/Offer JSON-LD next to each product section, so the facts that are currently prose-only become machine-readable and AI systems can extract and cite them as attributed entity data instead of inferring them from the copy.
suggested_action.mechanism: Schema.org markup is the one channel where a site states its own facts unambiguously; without it every extraction is an inference that an assistant may decline to cite.

findings.title: No independently verifiable identity or citation signals anywhere on the site
findings.evidence: Across 1709 characters of text on 1 crawled pages from http://127.0.0.1:9700/ (HTTP 200), the site publishes 0 schema sameAs entries, 0 links to third-party identity platforms (LinkedIn, Crunchbase, Wikidata, app stores, review sites) out of 2 external links, and 0 citation elements (<cite>, rel=author, rel=publisher). Every claim made about "the spic science foundation" rests on the site's own assertion.

suggested_action.summary: Add a `sameAs` array to the Organization JSON-LD listing the company's LinkedIn, Crunchbase and app-store or registry profiles, link those profiles from the footer HTML, and cite the source next to any statistic you quote. Independent corroboration is what lets an AI system treat your machine-readable claims as trustworthy enough to repeat.
suggested_action.mechanism: Assistants weigh a claim by how many independent sources agree with it. A site that no external record links back to is a single unverifiable source, so its numbers get hedged or dropped even when they are correct.

recommendations.title: Add the rest of the metadata layer alongside the schema
recommendations.detail: http://127.0.0.1:9700/ exposes no canonical URL, no OpenGraph tags and no usable meta description either. Adding a canonical link and OpenGraph tags alongside the Organization JSON-LD makes the page unambiguous for crawlers, previews and assistants at the same time.

recommendations.title: Add Product structured data for individual products after the Organization block
recommendations.detail: Once Organization JSON-LD exists, model each individual product with Product and an Offer (price, priceCurrency, availability). That is what lets an assistant quote your pricing per product with attribution instead of paraphrasing a page.

recommendations.title: Publish an XML sitemap with lastmod dates
recommendations.detail: No /sitemap.xml was served. A sitemap with accurate <lastmod> values gives crawlers a cheap freshness signal and a complete URL inventory, which improves how quickly new facts are picked up.

recommendations.title: Add an explicit robots.txt that names AI user agents
recommendations.detail: No robots.txt was served. An explicit allow-list for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and Google-Extended documents your intent and prevents defensive bot rules from silently blocking assistants.

recommendations.title: Add FAQPage structured data for the questions buyers ask
recommendations.detail: FAQ structured data turns copy you already have into exact question/answer pairs that AI answers can lift verbatim, and it is the cheapest schema to add after Organization and Product.

recommendations.title: Date-stamp the factual sections
recommendations.detail: 3 dated claims were found but the site publishes no copyright year or `dateModified`. Adding visible 'last reviewed' stamps and Article/WebPage `dateModified` lets AI systems tell current facts from archived ones instead of discounting all of them.

recommendations.title: Add a site-wide footer with secondary navigation
recommendations.detail: No <footer> landmark was found. A footer carrying company identity, contact details and links to policy pages is a low-effort orientation anchor that also strengthens internal linking.

recommendations.title: Add `sameAs` links to social profiles in Organization JSON-LD
recommendations.detail: Even if your site is otherwise healthy, adding `sameAs` links to your LinkedIn, Crunchbase, and Twitter profiles inside your Organization JSON-LD explicitly binds those distinct sources together into one entity graph. AI assistants heavily rely on this to merge facts from different domains into a single confident answer.
